runner: Gemini 3.6 Flash High via Antigravity IDE
notes: Single-shot run in Antigravity IDE. Full-page HTML5 canvas with multi-layered parallax scrolling (cinematic sunset sky gradients, distant mountain peaks with atmospheric haze, mid-ground pine hills, procedural roadside trees, utility poles with sagging cables, streetlights with light beams, fast-moving road asphalt, kerbs, and grass). Features a highly detailed sports GT coupe with metallic paint highlights, spinning alloy rims with brake calipers, glowing LED headlights & taillights, exhaust particle simulation, suspension bobbing & road-bump pitch dynamics.
